name: Admin Panel Projects Module
description: The Plataforma space in the panel sidebar opens /panel/projects: the commercial face of accounts.Project, the entity hostings, incomes and cuentas de cobro reference. The listing loads once and filters client-side by the active, user-managed lifecycle catalog: each state has a header count and appears in the Estado selector, alongside the manual-review bucket for migrated legacy rows. Search remains accent/case-blind over project and client, sortable columns show name/client/state/created plus per-project hosting and income counts that — for superusers — link into the accounting tabs pre-filtered via ?project=<id>. The Clientes sin proyecto card keeps its literal meaning: only clients with no Project row, and it opens the create path pre-seeded with that client. Create asks for name plus client and defaults to En desarrollo unless an initial catalog state is selected; later lifecycle changes are excluded from edit and belong to the previewed transition flow. A same-name project warns without blocking. At 412px and 835px state filtering is a selector, sorting stays explicit and the listing becomes one/two-column cards; from 1195px the table returns. Create, edit, orphan assignment, client change and lifecycle dialogs are full-screen on phones, with sticky actions; the page is capped at 1400px on wide monitors.
